specialRules.ruleFull: Warriors within 6" of the Protector of the Hunt may use his Leadership instead of their own.
An Elder Scout may shoot while hiding. After the shot roll a D6: on a 5 or more nobody saw where the arrow came from.
While an Elder Scout is hidden, each enemy model must pass a further Initiative test to spot him.
The Forest Mage is a wizard and starts with one Woodland Incantation chosen at random.
If more than one Scout henchman shoots at the same target, they have +1 on the injury roll.

fighters.name: Ivy Ferret
fighters.equipment: None. An Ivy Ferret may carry no weapons or armour.

specialRules.ruleFull: An Ivy Ferret stays beside its keeper, any Hero of the warband, and moves with him.

Nobody may attack an Ivy Ferret directly. For each hit on its keeper roll a D6: on a 6 the Ivy Ferret is hit instead. Once it has been hit and survived it hides for the rest of that combat, and may neither be hit nor attack again.
An Ivy Ferret is not affected by any poison.
An Ivy Ferret is a woodland spirit and gains no experience.
An Ivy Ferret's bite counts as coated with black lotus. It may attack in each round its keeper may attack.

specialSkillsList.name: Elven Luck
specialSkillsList.description: Once per game the Wood Elf may re-roll any failed roll.

specialSkillsList.name: Excellent Sight
specialSkillsList.description: The Hero spots hidden enemies from twice his Initiative in inches.

specialSkillsList.name: Seeker (Wood Elves of Arden)
specialSkillsList.description: Only one Hero of the warband may have this skill. When rolling on the Exploration chart the Hero may change the result of one dice by +1 or -1.

flags.what: A Wood Elf warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported. No henchmen group sizes and no maximum profiles are printed, so the Elves take our Elf race.

The skill table was read from a page image: the Protector of the Hunt ticks Combat, Shooting, Academic, Speed and Special; the Elder Scout Combat, Speed and Special; the Forest Mage Shooting, Academic, Speed and Special. Nobody ticks Strength.
The Ithilmar Weapon (price x 2) and the Ithilmar Armour (60 gc) are starred, and the PDF prints no footnote for the star on either list.
List prices as printed: Elven Cloak 75 gc, Ithilmar Armour 60 gc, Hunting Arrows 35 gc, Elven Wine 50 gc, Elf Bow 35 gc. Ours are priced otherwise, and are left alone.
The Ivy Ferret's Movement is printed as "-": it stays beside its keeper, which is kept as its Keeper rule.
Woodland Incantations is the lore we already hold from the Wood Elves of Athel Loren: the same six spells with the same difficulties, so the Forest Mage casts ours.

The five special skills are word for word the Wood Elves of Athel Loren's (their PDF, p5), but that warband is Mordheim 2a and this one Mousillon, and a skill carries its setting, so this is a group of its own rather than a shared one. Fey and Infiltration are ours; Elven Luck and Excellent Sight are kept apart as they are there; Seeker is named Seeker (Wood Elves of Arden), as our Kislev Ranger's Seeker holds the plain name, and its "only one Elven Hero" opens its description.
